id: title:andrewm4894:raise the per run gateway token cap to 15 for implementation runs

review.posthog_relevance: Adds tiered AI gateway token spend limits and shared caps to PostHog's AI gateway configuration, allowing product-specific overrides while retaining global maximums.
review.reason: Adds documentation and configuration for tiered AI gateway token caps, including a product-specific override and a shared cap limit. Establishes a shared maximum cap and decimal precision guard, and a helper to safely parse and validate cap values. Replaces the team-only cap lookup with a precedence-aware lookup: product override, then team override, then default.

observations.behavior: Adds a shared maximum cap and decimal precision guard, and a helper to safely parse and validate cap values.
